catalog.title: Native catalog
catalog.description: Read-only catalog of officially published specifications and prices. Developers verify and update sources. Compatible APIs never use this catalog.
price.followHelp: Clear all stored input, output, cache and media rates to follow catalog prices. Rates missing from the catalog remain unset.
compatible.help: Compatible APIs require administrator-supplied models and required prices. They never use catalog prices or capabilities.
compatible.baseHelp: Enter the full HTTPS URL, including its base path. Do not use an official native endpoint.
compatible.baseError: Enter a valid custom API URL.
compatible.requiredRates: Enter the required manual rates for this compatible model.
decisions.label: Decisions
decisions.help: Supports structured decision questions over shared input. Execution permission is checked separately.
price.cacheHelp: Cache rates use manual settings or the native catalog. Missing rates are not assumed free.
price.precedence: Manual prices take precedence over published prices.
price.cacheSummary: Cache read {read} · cache write {write} · long cache write {long} USD / 1M tokens
